models_evaluated: MIRAI (Original, with and without pectoral muscle)
Fine-tuned MIRAI (with and without pectoral muscle)

links.outcome: 1-5 year breast cancer risk discrimination (AUC) after fine-tuning MIRAI on local Slovenian mammograms
links.effect: Fine-tuned MIRAI on mammograms with pectoral muscle removed reached AUC 0.82-0.93 with screening positive exams and 0.71-0.79 without, versus 0.77-0.91 and 0.64-0.67 for Original MIRAI.
links.quote: Fine-tuned MIRAI on mammograms with PM removed achieved significantly higher 1-5 Year BCR discrimination performance (with screening positive exams: 0.82-0.93, without screening positive exams: 0.71-0.79).

unlisted_practices: Removing pectoral muscle from mammograms during training or fine-tuning of a risk prediction model
Assessing the relative contribution of image regions to predictions with saliency maps

screen.reason: The study tests an image-preprocessing safeguard/pipeline adjustment (pectoral muscle removal) and recalibration to improve model robustness, calibration, and discrimination across international screening datasets.

primary.practice: image preprocessing and pectoral muscle removal for model fine-tuning and calibration
